scope: standalone original certificate authentication gate, not yet enforced by the G8 phase-one receiver
signature_hash: original SHA-512 H2S/v2, 252-bit masked strict canonical first-candidate rejection sampling
threshold_roles: q_cert=n-t authenticates the DKG key; tau=t+1 is the separate private decryption threshold
bootstrap_trust: pre-authorized trustee identity public keys, registration authority and election/manifest identity are trust roots; their signatures certify values, not the bootstrap authority itself
